analysis.patternNote: 5일간의 가격 움직임이 52주 고가 대비 78.1% 수준에서 횡보하며, 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일하게 유지되고 있어 명확한 방향성 없이 축적 구간을 이어가고 있다.

keyPointsEn: RSI at 38.9 signals potential for a bounce as it enters oversold territory, but the MACD histogram remains weak, indicating a faint trend reversal signal.
Current price ($729.46) is below SMA5 ($737.30) and SMA20 ($745.79), facing short-term selling pressure, but is supported above SMA100 ($715.86) and SMA200 ($696.49).
Volume ratio at 1.56 indicates strong momentum behind the price movement, yet the price continues to trade sideways between the swing support ($722.59) and resistance ($749.53).
